description: Source code for the xprepare module of the LibXDiff library, implementing file differencing and comparison functions.

classes.name: xdlclass_t
classes.description: Represents a class of record with hash and length information.

classes.name: xdlclassifier_t
classes.description: Classifier structure for grouping records based on hash.

methods.name: xdl_init_classifier
methods.description: Initializes the classifier with specified size and flags.

methods.name: xdl_free_classifier
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the classifier.

methods.name: xdl_classify_record
methods.description: Classifies a record into the classifier, updating hash buckets.

methods.name: xdl_free_ctx
methods.description: Frees context data for a file.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_ctx
methods.description: Prepares context for file comparison, including hashing and classification.

methods.name: xdl_free_env
methods.description: Frees environment data for file comparison.

methods.name: xdl_clean_mmatch
methods.description: Determines if a line should be discarded based on neighboring line actions.

methods.name: xdl_cleanup_records
methods.description: Removes records with no matches or potential for discard in comparison.

methods.name: xdl_trim_ends
methods.description: Trims matching records from the start and end of files.

methods.name: xdl_optimize_ctxs
methods.description: Optimizes comparison contexts by trimming and cleaning records.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_env
methods.description: Prepares environment for file comparison, initializing classifiers and contexts.
